text:
incident-bot: Paging: HIGH-PRIO: spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings (us-west). error-rate 18% over 60s, p95 latency 2.1s. impact: select customers reporting wrong response shapes. auto-fallback triggered to variant 'chat-instruct-v2'
Maya Patel: I'm on it, grabbing logs and routing config.
On-call (SRE): I'm taking pager. can someone confirm which alias/anchor changed in the last 30m?
Ryan Chen: looks like a promo deploy touched alias-mapping for model: 'redwood-emb-4b' -> alias 'emb-best' 28m ago. i'm pulling the rollout.
Anita Gomez: alert shows a bunch of embedding requests falling back to a chat/instruct runtime (schema mismatch). customers get JSON with "messages" instead of embedding arrays.
EVA-bot: Deploy 2026-05-17T18:22 by @release-bot: updated alias-mapping service. rollback available.
Maya Patel: repro locally by sending an embeddings request:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"emb-best","input":"hello"}'
```
response shows an object with `choices[0].message.content` (chat) instead of `embedding` array.
On-call (SRE): confirmed. high 5xx rate correlates with code path in fallback router where pinned variant is incompatible; fallback policy is 'compatible-or-fallback' and it's routing to nearest region variant which happens to be chat-instruct.
infra-eng: quick mitigation options: 1) unpin alias -> route to stable emb-only variant, 2) disable fallback policy for embeddings, 3) toggle region routing to prefer dedicated emb cluster. We should do 1) then 3).
Ryan Chen: i'll unpin alias mapping now. running: `rg 'alias: emb-best' && curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/aliases/emb-best/unpin -H "Authorization: ..."`
Maya Patel: ETA on unpin?
Ryan Chen: unpin done. patch id 0c3a. verifying traffic.
EVA-bot: Traffic shift: emb-best -> emb-best@stable (100%) applied.
Maya Patel: error-rate dropping to 2% after unpin. p95 latency back to 120ms. embedding shape correct for sampled requests.
On-call (SRE): keep monitoring for 10m. set alert to 3% threshold.
Raj (Customer Success): I see two active customers in us-west receiving malformed responses — AcmePay and NovaDocs. notifying them via status: "We are mitigating an embedding routing issue; there may have been malformed responses. We'll follow up with details and any impacted request ids."
Anita Gomez: root cause quick notes: alias-mapping deployment introduced an alias pin override that matched by model family only (not interface), so emb requests in us-west hit a pinned variant that was chat-specialized. fallback logic then sent to chat runtime in other regions due to capacity skew, creating a tight regional fallback loop and schema mismatches.
Ryan Chen: adding a short-term guard: patching router to check interface compatibility before using pinned variant. pushing hotfix: `PATCH /router/config` payload `{"check_interface":true}`
On-call (SRE): hotfix applied. router now rejects pinned variant if interface != requested interface.
EVA-bot: Hotfix deploy successful.
Maya Patel: monitoring shows embedding 5xxs resolved and no new malformed responses in last 6 minutes.
Raj (Customer Success): I've sent a follow-up message to affected customers with a request-id sample and ETA for postmortem.
Anita Gomez: follow-ups for postmortem: timeline, root cause (alias pin override), why fallback policy allowed incompatible runtime, why regional capacity preferences created the loop, corrective actions, and checklist for preventing regresses (unit test for interface-aware aliasing, canary gating on alias changes).
Maya Patel: immediate actions recorded: 1) unpin alias (done), 2) hotfix router interface check (done), 3) revert problematic alias-deploy config in CI (created PR #4352), 4) notify customers (Raj sent msgs).
On-call (SRE): i'm handing back to infra-eng and product to own follow-up. leaving note: if any residual errors spike above 3% re-pager.
Maya Patel: thanks all. i'll draft the incident thread for postmortem and attach request-ids / logs. will tag eng-runtime, product, and cust-success.
Ryan Chen: small add — we should consider adding a safelist in fallback policy: only allow fallback to variants that advertise compatible I/O. scheduling a deeper change in the routing service.
EVA-bot: Incident auto-close check in 30m unless new alerts.
Maya Patel: closing the active page, keeping the thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
